## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing page hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. (UK).

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On the policy list, word for word. Source is the October 2026 review export, which is current. |
| Organic loose leaf | Covered by "Certified organic by the Soil Association" (certificate renewed 2026). |
| Plastic-free bags | Covered by "plastic-free and home compostable" (EN 13432 certificate). |
| Packed by hand in Bristol | On the policy list as "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol". |

**Regulated claims:** No health, money, legal, children or price claims. The environmental wording is limited to "plastic-free", which the policy backs with a certificate. There is no broad "eco" or "sustainable" language.

**House style:** Warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. Score about 90. It is two short, concrete sentences, so I changed nothing.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own landing page, so no ad, partnership or affiliate label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing.

**Needs a decision:** One minor point. The policy says "every *tin*" is hand-packed, and the draft says "plastic-free bags, packed by hand". If the tea bags ship in boxes rather than tins, confirm with operations that hand-packing applies to them too. If it does, no change is needed. If not, change it to "loose leaf tins packed by hand in Bristol".

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). I haven't recorded any approval. Sam needs to say yes to this exact copy before it goes live.
